name: fyers-equity-delivery-sell-1k
describes: A Rs 1,000 delivery sell at Fyers, where brokerage is 0.3% rather than the Rs 20 cap. Every other fixture prices Rs 1,00,000, at which the cap binds and a wrong percentage cannot be seen — which is exactly how the card shipped at 0.1% and passed. Below Rs 6,667 the rate is what is charged, so this is the size that tests it.
